attributes.action: Give school students the day off if England were to get to the World Cup ro16
attributes.additional_details: To be able to let the students watch the game and show their country support. However if they had to go to school it would make them tired and distracted at school the next day
attributes.background: Give us a day off because if England top the group and get to the World Cup round of 16, the kick off time here is at 1am on Monday 6th July which is a school night which makes the students tired if they had to go to school

rejection.details: When our team got to your petition in the petitions queue, the date of the England vs Mexico World Cup game had already passed.
